raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
A stop_token_ids entry outside [0, vocab_size) passed request validation and then hit a device-side assert in the min_new_tokens penalizer's scatter, crashing the server and every in-flight request. Validate it in SamplingParams.verify() alongside logit_bias so the request gets a 400.

Fixes #44535

detail.title: [Fix] sampling: Reject out-of-vocab stop_token_ids in verify()

files.patch:
@@ -276,6 +276,15 @@ def verify(self, vocab_size):
                         f"logit_bias must has keys in [0, {vocab_size - 1}], got "
                         f"{token_id}."
                     )
+        if self.stop_token_ids is not None:
+            # The min_new_tokens penalizer scatters these into a [batch, vocab_size + 1]
+            # tensor; an out-of-range id is a device-side assert that kills the server.
+            for token_id in self.stop_token_ids:
+                if not 0 <= token_id < vocab_size:
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"stop_token_ids must be in [0, {vocab_size - 1}], got "
+                        f"{token_id}."
+                    )
         if self.sampling_seed is not None:
             if not isinstance(self.sampling_seed, int):
                 raise ValueError(

@@ -315,6 +315,30 @@ def test_logit_bias_valid_tokens(self):
         sp = self._make(logit_bias={"0": 1.0, "31999": -0.5})
         sp.verify(self.VOCAB_SIZE)
 
+    # --- stop_token_ids ---
+    def test_stop_token_ids_exceeds_vocab_raises(self):
+        """Test that verify() rejects stop_token_ids with token_id >= vocab_size.
+
+        An out-of-range id crashes the min_new_tokens penalizer's scatter with a
+        device-side assert, so it must be rejected at request validation.
+        """
+        for token_id in (self.VOCAB_SIZE, 1000000):
+            with self.subTest(token_id=token_id):
+                sp = self._make(stop_token_ids=[1, token_id])
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                    sp.verify(self.VOCAB_SIZE)
+
+    def test_stop_token_ids_negative_raises(self):
+        """Test that verify() rejects stop_token_ids with a negative token_id."""
+        sp = self._make(stop_token_ids=[-1])
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+            sp.verify(self.VOCAB_SIZE)
+
+    def test_stop_token_ids_valid_tokens(self):
+        """Test that stop_token_ids within [0, vocab_size) are accepted."""
+        sp = self._make(stop_token_ids=[0, self.VOCAB_SIZE - 1])
+        sp.verify(self.VOCAB_SIZE)
+
     # --- sampling_seed ---
     def test_sampling_seed_valid(self):
         """Test that None (the default) and the int64 min/max boundaries are accepted."""
